verdict.rationale: Docs show TypeScript-based scaffolding (`create-playcanvas` with Vite/TypeScript) and a VS Code extension for local script editing, implying some typed API surface, but there is no explicit mention of an official language server, published .d.ts completions, diagnostics, or navigation tooling. A community comment even notes TypeScript support was only 'coming' after ESM/NPM work, underscoring immaturity. missing for 10: explicit LSP/editor-plugin documentation, published type-definition files, and evidence of completions/diagnostics/navigation working in an editor.
